# NVIDIA (NVDA) analysis, as of 15 Nov 2026

**Summary:** NVDA closed at **$162.85** on 13 Nov 2026, its lowest close in 52 weeks. It is down about 21% in two weeks and trades at its lowest trailing multiples in Equibles' history (back to 2020): **20.6× P/E and 19.4× EV/EBITDA**. The main reason is that Jensen Huang has left as CEO. An Equibles 8-K summary says he resigned as President, CEO and director on 11 Nov 2026. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO and Harvey C. Jones is the first Board Chair. The business was still growing fast at the last report: revenue of $96B, more than double the prior year, and a 70% growth outlook for FY2028. Q3 FY27 results are expected next week.

Each figure is tagged **[EQ]** for Equibles or **[FD]** for Financial Datasets. I used **14 Equibles requests**.

---

3× and a median forward P/E of 17.9×.
- Earnings have been growing faster than the share price for three years, so the multiple has kept shrinking. The latest drop is about risk (the leadership change and politics), not weaker profits.
